notes.title: Introducing House of Empty Names!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209455/a16346fd6f011c6fab822adc25612fd38b18f143.png"][/img]Hello everyone,
[/p][p]We’ve been working on our next game called [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3834600/House_of_Empty_Names/"]House of Empty Names[/url][b].[/b][/p][p] [/p][p]It’s deeper, more complex, and more atmospheric.[/p][p]New story. More mechanics. More tension.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve learned from the first game and made something much stronger.  [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="4ZIBIK28Wos;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]If you enjoyed Echoes of the House, please consider adding the new game to your wishlist.[/p][p]
Thanks for your support.[/p]

notes.title: Release!
notes.notes:
The game has been officially released!

I have a hotfix planned for tomorrow to resolve any issues.

Thank you all for your patience and support.

notes.title: Release Trailer
notes.notes: Release [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3229140/Echoes_Of_The_House/]trailer[/url] has been published on the Steam Page!

notes.title: Exciting News
notes.notes:
I’m thrilled to announce that the game is set to release in the upcoming weeks!

The official release date along with a brand-new trailer will be revealed very soon!

Thank you for your patience.

notes.title: Development Continues
notes.notes:
I'm continuing to work hard on Echoes of the House and have some exciting updates to share. 

I have been adding even more details to create a deep and tense atmosphere that will pull you into every moment of the game. For those who love to spot the tiniest clues, I've prepared plenty of surprises!

Your feedback is very important for me. You can get in direct contact with me using [url=https://discord.gg/ehWdAH5H96]Discord[/url].
Thank you for your support! Stay tuned, there’s a lot more to come!
